verdict.rationale: Reflect documents a custom `reflect://` URI scheme for running in-app actions (docs-3, docs-38), with a documented command that appends text to today's daily note (docs-46). Its OAuth-based API also supports appending data to notes (docs-17, docs-45). The evidence does not show deep-link commands for creating a new note or opening an arbitrary note, so the story's create/open core is only partly covered. missing for 10: documented create-note and open-specific-note deep-link commands, a full command reference, a local endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
